title: Magical day with Noella
text: I had a fantastic time discovering and discussing the life of Dali with Noelia! She also took me to a great local place for lunch and later treated me to a traditional local dessert in Girona.  Our walk in Girona was delightful and very picturesque.  Really a "wow" day all the way around.  Highly recommended.
author: M698JRrd

title: Day trip to girona
text: Luis was extremely knowledgeable during our time at the Dali Museum. I’m absolutely blown away. His driving was great as well as his knowledge in Girona. He was a great person to spend the day with.

title: Full Fun Day!
text: Great way to spend the day! Staying in Barcelona it was so nice to escape for a day and explore the Dalí museum and Girona. Luis knows his stuff!! Kind and considerate, it was the perfect way to wrap up our week here.

title: An Incredible Day Exploring Dalí and Girona with Luis
text:
We had an absolutely fantastic day with Luis as our private guide exploring the Dalí Museum in Figueres and the beautiful city of Girona.

Luis was exceptional from start to finish. His knowledge of the history, art, culture, and local area was incredible, but what really made the day special was his personality, patience, and genuine passion for what he does.

title: Fantastic and Informative trip to Girona and Dali Museum
text: Noelia was fantastic! We spent a very nice day traveling to Girona and the Dali Museum. Without Noelia we would not understand Dali’s work of art and his life at all. She was very informative. We enjoyed a nice lunch and the weather was perfect. She introduced us to Xuxoa which was quite delicious. We would have never tried without her suggestion. Thank you for a wonderful day!
author: GoinsOhio

title: Excellent private Girona and Dali tour
text:
Noelia was very friendly and knowledgeable about the history of Dali and his life, work, and museum, as well as Figueres and Girona. She was an excellent driver also. Helped us choose a very nice place for lunch.
I highly recommend her and this tour.
author: phuongnG2724VX

title: Perfect day trip out of Barcelona
text: Fantastic day trip out of Barcelona. Once in a lifetime chance to see the Dali museum and it didn't disappoint. Our guide Noelia, a real Catalan, told us many interesting things about the art and about the man and was obviously very passionate about it. We then went to Girona, saw the amazing cathedral and walked around the old city and the wall, and enjoyed the xuixo. Noelia catered the tour to our interests, which we really appreciated. Super convenient pick up and drop off right at our stay too.  Great!
author: gylm2016

title: Viator tour of Girona and Salvador Dali
text: Noelia took us on a tour of Salvador Dali’s museum/theater. The tour was the highlight of our trip. She was extremely knowledgeable with Dali’s life and art work. It felt like she knew him personally. We didn’t want the tour to end.
